verdict.rationale: ClickUp works as a shared context hub. Its official MCP server lets external AI agents read and act on workspace tasks, lists, and docs. The API supports task comments, attachments, and carrying custom fields across lists. Its marketing says internal agents and models (Super Agent, Brain²) run with 'full context' and 'infinite memory' and can take delegated tasks. However, nothing documents an actual agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff mechanism that preserves context, so the delegation and context claims rest on homepage marketing only. Missing for 10: documented handoff protocol between agents/tools, evidence of context or memory persisting across a handoff, independent or hands-on corroboration.
